reviews.text: The mobile vet service came to my home after I discovered that an older, "bones thin" and injured female cat was in my fully block walled back yard had somehow wound up there. The circumstances are weird, but she made me so sad when she tried to walk to me mewing as if for help. We called Paradise Point and they sent out a mobile unit. The vet services were wonderful. We discussed what was the top priority to check and they started testing for anything that couldn't present an imminent serious issue, shaved back her unreally matted fur (exposing how boney she really was) and gave her an IV to hydrate her. They were WONDERFUL! I cannot tell you how much I appreciated both of them and their medical help and their compassion for this poor cat who didn't look like she would even survive much longer without help. I cannot say enough good about these two who tended to this little girl. We will be following up with them to assure that we are able to set her on the right track for healing. They have a new customer now....me....and my new cat. I cannot thank them enough!
Thorough, kind, great care. They were running late due to an emergency,  but that was explained and I could either wait or reschedule.
We took Scout to see Dr Casey today for a routine checkup. From the reception area til the time we left we were treated with respect and caring attitude. Thank you Dr.Casey and Nick.

CALLED TO GET A SCRIPT FOR MY DOG FOR FOURTH OF JULY  BC fireworks....... 3:00 yes it was last min but I had forgotten. Anyways the guy says ill put it in and ask the Dr ..... 2  hours later I call to check... Oh Idk
Im still waiting for someone.... What???    Im calling back  @5:00 you close at 6:00 and you cant tell me if I can get the script???????        Oh well we are going to be here way past closing g which is 6:00 ..... Finally calls me back at 6:40pm unacceptable.... And says sorry we are not going to be able to fill the script………IM SORRY WHAT??????  Yo should have said that 3  hours ago!!!!! Youre playing games and for that i willl never take my dog there!!!!!!!!!!
Great staff! Knowledgeable and caring. Couldn't recommend enough. Weven been coming here for years!

Dr Garthe and team are very caring and were empathetic with my senior cat.  She treated her pain and did a comprehensive exam.  She covered a lot and explained everything.  I love that she offers non-traditional medicine (CTM) as well and we are going to look into that.  I did the mobile Vet service which was less stressful for my pet.  Highly recommend Dr. Garthe and team and the “on the go” service is great!   Thank you to Val the tech for great communication and compassion.
Great care and surgery for our golden doodle.

They are kind and understanding. I struggle w scheduling and never do they complain.
They absolutely adore The WoobieCat! He gets so much love and affection, I never worry about how he will be treated if I  cannot be in the room.
I have known Dr Garthe for 25-30 years+
I went looking for her again, THAT is how much I like and trust her as a vet!
She is SO thorough and knowledgeable.
Her staff works doubletime to make sure my cat is comfortable and not afraid. And the office is spotless! ...means a lot! You go into some clinics and you kinda wonder, but not @ Paradise Point.
A very well,run office, filled with kind, loving, pet people who know their veterinary science.

Thank you for taking amazing care of Alfie for his neuter! I highly recommend Paradise Point Animal Hospital- during his stay, we received multiple text updates and we could tell he was so loved throughout the entire process. His incision is already healing wonderfully. ❤️
Friendly staff,  great doctors

My senior cat injured his back and developed a limp tail, and we were worried about potential nerve issues. Paradise Point was able to get us in the very next day. The vet and staff were thorough and clear— they walked us through possible diagnoses, what symptoms to watch for, and treatment options. We did cold laser therapy on the hurt spot in his back and were sent home with pain management. He’s now back to normal, and having a diagnosis and knowing exactly where he was hurting helped us care for him and prevent flare-ups. I was very happy with the staff and the vet, and grateful to have a clinic I trust for his care.
Wonderful, caring, professional care of my dog, Ginny.

Not much good to say. Overpriced, brought my dog in at 8am to picked up at 4pm, when I called at 4pm to pick her up they told me "I'm sorry we haven't gotten to her yet". No call throughout the day telling me so and to add insult they charged me $680 to hold her and give her a sedative for the never happening surgery. I'd look around for other options unless you have excess funds to burn.

I am always so grateful and impressed by our experience at Paradise Point Animal Hospital. The staff always seems to know who we are and are ready with Kahlo's history when I call. Dr. Casey is an absolute gem. She's so dedicated and offers sound advice based on experience. She always makes sure I understand the options and why. I 100%, appreciate her and am worried few Drs are like her! And Kahlo (the actual patient) loves to go. She loves everyone there. While the location happens to also be extremely convenient, I'd be willing to travel here for veterinary care and recommend to anyone within manageable distance.
As an example of how dedicated this place is - We were there Tuesday for some blood tests. That Thursday at Thanksgiving my family and I were griping about healthcare on the human side, and the need to follow up, difficulty getting answers, etc. I said Paradise Point Animal Hospital will not need follow up, they are a world away from what we have for human care. Well the very next morning - the morning after Thanksgiving when most of us are dilly-dallying - Dr. Casey was already leaving me a voicemail with Kahlo's blood results. Talk about on top if it. I am so blown away and so appreciative. None of my words can adequately express.

We've taken our dogs to see Dr. Garthe for nearly 20 years and she is the best! Over the weekend, our old dog (18 year old Aussie) seemed to be in a lot of pain. Paradise Point worked us in right away. Our AUssie had an ear infection and she also has arthritis. We were given meds for both. I could tell my her behavior and eyes that she was feeling better the next day.
I can't recommend Dr Garthe enough!
The staff were all great! The two at the front desk, the vet tech and the Vet. I will definitely be bringing my Tootsie there for all her beer needs.

We are so happy with the care and expertise we received At Paradise Point Animal Hospital. Our dog has a spine injury and it is critical we get great physical therapy for her. We were able to be seen right away and the staff were very prepared for our visit. Thank you so much Paradise Point!

I will forever be grateful to Paradise Point Animal Hospital. They are very professional and care so much for your animal. They all went above and beyond to save my cat's life and make sure he was okay and comfortable. By far the most genuine animal hospital I have ever been to and I would 10 out of 10 recommend to anyone!
We have been going to this Vet for years because they have great customer service and really care about my pups..

I met this staff at the worst time possible, and they took good care of me and my girl in her final hours.
Now they have been taking amazing care of my boy Lokie. EVERYONE is so caring, thoughtful and knowledgeable. It's truly a joy bringing him here and knowing they are taking the very best care of my boy Lokie
Amazing!

I started taking my cat, Henry, to Dr. Casey in late November/early December 2024. I wanted to find an integrative/holistic vet after my previous integrative vet moved out of the country. Henry and I both LOVE Dr. Casey! She and the rest of the staff answered all the questions I had, and were so attentive to mine and my cat's needs. I was also pleased when I told them Henry only gets fed canned. and fresh food, they did not bash me for my feeding choice for him (which, a few vets have questioned in the past), and told me to keep doing what I'm doing because it was clearly working for him. I signed up for the senior wellness plan that day, got Henry's bloodwork done not too long after that, and had his dental cleaning in January this year, all of which was covered by the wellness plan. Henry and I will DEFINITELY be back to see Dr. Casey in the future!

The best experience I have ever had at a vet. Came in for an injury on my kittens back leg, made an appointment same day as I didn’t want to leave out of town without her being seen in case her wound worsened while I was gone. The level of care, patience and time that we received from the vet tech and the vet made me feel so comfortable. They were to the point but also so friendly and knowledgeable. I didn’t feel rushed.  ALL of my questions and concerns were answered with compassion. It feels like they love animals here, kind of the only way I can explain it. Some vets offices have made me feel like a number, not the case at this office. I know that when I have to make the difficult decision to help my elderly dog, I will be bringing her here with confidence that she will be treated with love.
Rounder is always well cared for by Dr Garthe and her staff.  Rounder is difficult but they take care of hm whether he likes it of not! Caring and compassionate!

They've been wonderful. Between making appointments available if you have something urgent going on. Very communicative . My one cat needed dental surgery and they understand I was worried about the cost so instead of pressuring me into having it there they gave me resources for a place that has discounted rates.  They've been so helpful with my other cat figuring out her issues and working with me and being available for questions. Everyone is so friendly. My cat actually feels comfortable going to this vet and has not had vet aggression since I switched. The people are usually always the same and the doctors are super personable, go out of their way to answer questions and explain in much detail about what things could be and multiple ways of treating things without feeling pressured into something I wouldn't want for my pets. I can't say enough good things. I've been to 3 or 4 vets since I have lived here and this is by far the one that not just I like but my CATS like as well. They see the familiar faces and know they're going to be well taken care of ❤️ thank you Paradise point .

just wanted to leave our experience here because i am somehow still getting emails from them after unsubscribing.
if you are a young pet owner please do not come here under any circumstances. we brought our young dog in quite awhile ago in 2023 when she was still under a year old. she showed obvious signs of distress and urinary incontinence and other issues like GI distress and extreme thirst that were NOT consistent with typical potty training patterns etc and we had already seen many other vets and just needed more answers and was recommended dr garthe by a friend.

not only did she claim our dog was “manipulating” us and her symptoms were purely behavioral without doing any tests or labs, she also insinuated irresponsibility on our part because we were “too young” and claimed we didn’t know what we were doing. she said we needed to take away all of her bedding because her having accidents at night was her “wrapping us around her little finger”. i left that appointment crying and i assumed i must be wrong, so i removed all of her bedding that night as she said. i woke up to a traumatized dog soaked in urine.

fast forward almost 2 years and many great competent vets and she has confirmed spay incontinence, IBD, and possibly kidney and pancreatic problems we are still working on.

if you have a puppy that is struggling with urinary and bowel incontinence and odd symptoms that just don’t seem right i highly recommend Dr Rudolph at university VCA and Dr Riensche at desert veterinary medical specialists. please save yourself the trauma of coming here.
Kim, thank you for the time and effort in giving us this review! Jim Garthe
Hi Janet, thank you for your review! Have a great day, Jim Garthe

We brought in our newly adopted 4 year old Chloe for a wellness check.  The staff was very welcoming and friendly and they made us feel as though we had been going there for years.

Dr. Casey was awesome!  She spent  quite a bit of time with us and provided a lot of good information.
The best local vet in the area. Dr Garthie is the best.
Tech named Beth was fantastic. My puppy loved her immediately and she just got down on the floor with him. I was impressed. She was knowledgeable and very friendly. Good experience. Thank you.
Thank you minami lol...! Jim Garthe

I feel like you always get a full explanation of what is wrong so you can take action or make the right decision for yourself.  Everyone is really friendly and even though my dog had to have major surgery at the location he’s still happy to go there
My dog is always happy at this vet and the staff are all very nice and good at what they do. Boone posed for a photo at their Halloween Photo Booth they have in the lobby! So fun!!

They got me and my kitty in on the day following a holiday weekend. There was a  rather long wait time due to being busy, but the staff checked in with us periodically. All were very pleasant and carefully explained various things that could be causing his recent illness. We are hoping for positive test results this week.
$7000 for my dogs teeth cleanings? I don’t understand how this place can charge rates this high. We will never come back.
Very pleased with the staff, ease of scheuling, and after care follow-up. They always take great care of my little guy.

I have been taking my pets to Dr Garthe for the last 15 years and highly recommend this practice.  All of my pets strangely go willingly through the door and enjoy the attention from the staff.  Keep up the great work!
very pleased with service and staff

If your dog needs any level of a procedure done, GO ELSEWHERE. The follow up care and communication is laughable. It was awful. I loved my experience here until my dog had a procedure done. My dog had to get a second surgery done at an emergency vet because they removed stitches too early and the wound reopened under 24 hours later. Paradise Point would not accept any responsibility or return my calls. I was told I would be receiving calls to address the situation multiple times and never did. It took them 11 days to respond to a single email. The front desk staff is INCREDIBLE at answering questions and are so pleasant to speak with, but that's the only positive I have to share about this pet hospital.
